summary.text: Bob Andersen is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 49, serving since 2024. His committee assignments are General Affairs, Government, Military and Veterans Affairs, and Urban Affairs.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Andersen was born February 11, 1963, in Tiffin, Ohio, and graduated from Seaholm High School in 1981.
He earned an associate degree in interpreting and translating Russian from the Community College of the U.S. Air Force in 1988 and a B.S. in business management from Peru State College in 2002.

His biography lists U.S. Air Force service from 1982 to 2003, past work as a Russian linguist, signals analyst and RC-135 aircrew member, and a current occupation as defense contractor and small business owner.
It lists him as married to Julie O'Donnell since March 16, 1996, with two children.
